title: Conveyor pick, carriage load, braking and dock unload
summary: At the start a small cube (the part) rides along a powered roller conveyor, and a shallow carriage is already coasting along a frictionless rail. Grasp the part with the gripper while it is moving and lift it; set it on the moving carriage and let go while the carriage is still moving; then grip the carriage (it has a vertical handle) and bring it to a stop with the part still on it; grasp the part again and lift it off the carriage; finally set it down in a fixed dock and leave it there at rest.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x), with no tool: the bare Panda hand and its two parallel fingers. The task's tool frame is the Panda TCP (between the fingertips). At the start the TCP is at (-0.13, -0.11, 0.21) with orientation wxyz (0, 1, 0, 0): the gripper points straight down, the hand's x axis along world x, the fingers closing along world y; the fingers start 0.048 m apart (each at 0.024 m). The action's last element is the total finger opening (0 to 0.08 m); in this task the gripper's motion is not time-synchronised with the arm joints' trajectory.
scene: An orange cube, the part (36 mm edge), lies on a roller conveyor (20 grey rollers of 6 mm radius and 0.136 m length, axes along x, 12.5 mm apart, on a dark frame) whose powered rollers carry it along +y toward the conveyor's end from t = 0; if nothing takes it, it reaches the end after a few seconds and falls off. A blue carriage (a shallow tray 0.17 m along x by 0.11 m inside, 9 mm walls, with a vertical blue handle 28 mm x 36 mm x 76 mm outside its +x wall) runs on a straight rail along y; it has no motor and no friction and is already coasting along +y at t = 0, and it keeps going until something stops it or it reaches the end of its rail. A blue open box, the dock (0.13 m x 0.12 m inside, 0.04 m deep), stands fixed just above the table. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Conveyor: centre (-0.13, -0.10, 0.1); roller j (j = 0..19) at y = -0.10 + (j - 9.5) x 0.0125 m (from -0.219 to 0.019), axis height z = 0.108 (tops at z = 0.114), friction 0.9; each roller is velocity-driven at -`incoming_speed`/0.006 rad/s about +x (surface speed `incoming_speed` = 0.08 m/s toward +y), drive damping 0.012, torque limit 0.008 N m, and starts already spinning at that rate. Frame box 0.16 x 0.28 x 0.024 m (z 0.053..0.077). Part: box half-extent 0.018 m, mass `object_mass` = 0.035 kg, friction 0.65, restitution 0.05; at reset at (-0.13, -0.16, 0.133) with velocity (0, `incoming_speed`, 0) = (0, 0.08, 0) m/s. Carriage: articulation with rail centre (0.12, 0, 0.11), prismatic along world +y, limits +-0.42 m, joint friction 0, damping 0, no drive; moving link mass 0.18 kg, tray inner half-size (0.085, 0.055) m, walls 9 mm high, floor top at the link origin (z = 0.11), friction 0.4; handle box 0.028 x 0.036 x 0.076 m centred at link (0.11, 0, 0.035). At reset the carriage starts at q0 = -0.16 + U(-0.01, 0.01) m (the only random draw) with velocity `fixture_speed` = 0.035 m/s along +y, and coasts at that speed; unbraked it reaches its +0.42 m limit after about (0.42 - q0)/0.035 = 16.6 s. Rail base: box 0.036 x 0.48 x 0.024 m at z 0.048..0.072 on a pedestal. Dock: static open box centred at (0.20, -0.23), floor top at z = 0.015, inner half-size (0.065, 0.06) m, walls 0.04 m high and 5 mm thick, friction 0.4, restitution 0.03. Finger friction 1.2 static / 1.0 dynamic. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08. No goal flags are announced.

phases.name: moving_acquisition
phases.text: at some step both fingers (left and right) touch the part while the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s; then, with both fingers still touching it, the part's centre is above world z = 0.20 m.

phases.name: loaded_carriage_release
phases.text: the part touches the carriage's moving body, is not held by both fingers (at most one finger touches it), and the carriage moves along its rail faster than 0.025 m/s, all at the same step.

phases.name: handle_braking
phases.text: both fingers touch the carriage's moving body (any part of it counts: handle, walls or floor), the carriage moves slower than 0.012 m/s, the part's centre is within 0.07 m of the carriage centre along both carriage-frame x and y (the carriage frame is world-aligned), and the part touches the carriage, for 0.25 s without interruption.

phases.name: payload_regrasp
phases.text: both fingers touch the part, its centre is above world z = 0.20 m, and it does not touch the carriage.

phases.name: dock_deposit
phases.text: the part is not held by both fingers, touches the dock, its centre is within 0.04 m (horizontal distance) of the dock's centre, and it moves slower than 0.03 m/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task.

task_failures: payload_spill: during handle_braking or payload_regrasp, the part's centre drops below world z = 0.09 m.
contact_rules: Only the two fingers may touch anything, and only the part and the carriage's moving body (its tray and handle). Every other contact of the robot is forbidden: the hand and arm links may touch nothing (not even the part or the carriage), and the fingers must not touch the conveyor (rollers or frame), the carriage's rail and base, the dock or the table.
world_goals_fixed: Lift height: the part's centre above world z = 0.20 m (moving_acquisition and payload_regrasp). Spill height: world z = 0.09 m (handle_braking and payload_regrasp). The delivery target is the dock's centre (a physical fixture; coordinates in privileged details).
difficulty_note: The part has to be grasped off a moving conveyor and placed on a carriage that keeps coasting, and the carriage can only be stopped by gripping it, without knocking the loose part off its shallow tray; every step is a real two-finger contact with no tool to absorb errors.
standard_notes: At t = 0 the part is already travelling along the conveyor toward its end, and the carriage is already coasting along its rail; neither stops by itself (the carriage only at the end of its rail, the part by falling off the conveyor's end).
